mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SilenceDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the center are also <status>Silenced</status> for the duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by <keywordMajor>Scarecrow Effigies</keywordMajor>. When discovered by enemies, <keywordMajor>Effigies</keywordMajor> briefly impersonate Fiddlesticks. If Fiddlesticks does not move for 2 seconds, he will impersonate an <keywordMajor>Effigy</keywordMajor>. At level six <keywordMajor>Effigies</keywordMajor> reveal nearby wards for 6 seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>A Harmless Scarecrow</titleLeft><mainText>Fiddlesticks is posing as an effigy.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for @FearDuration@ second(s).

Active: Fear an enemy for @FearDuration@ second(s) and deal @TotalPercentHealthDamage@ current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal @TotalPercentHealthDamageFeared@ current Health magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Deals a minimum of @MinimumDamage@ magic damage, or @MinimumDamage*2@ magic damage if the target has been recently Feared by Fiddlesticks.
Deals a maximum of 400 magic damage to minions and jungle monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Terrify</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is fleeing in terror. It ignores all orders.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fiddlesticks channels for @ChannelTime@ seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @Duration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing @DrainDamageCalc@ magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus @PercentForTooltip@% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores @VampPercentage@% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Healing based on pre-mitigation damage.
Against monsters, this Ability deals @MonsterDamageMod*100@% damage and heals @MonsterHealingMod*100@% of damage done.
Against minions, this Ability deals @MinionDamageMod*100@% damage and heals @MinionHealingMod@% of damage done.
